description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-cache (Caffeine) on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Cache panel light-up: the live cache topology read from the
        application's io.quarkus.cache.CacheManager by the QuarkusCacheProvider is shaped by the shared engine
        CacheService, Caffeine cache sizes + Micrometer cache metrics are overlaid, and the panel is surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/cache with a working POST /clear action. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO quarkus-cache, so the capability gate keeps
        the cache panel unavailable) so the cache-present and cache-absent paths are each proven in
        isolation — the same split used for the SmallRye-Health-present/absent and Micrometer-present/absent
        coverage.
